name: Security Warden
tagline: A careful second opinion before risky bot actions.
description: A careful second opinion before risky bot actions. Reviews proposed sends, deletes, and shell for secrets and personal info, then says go / ask you first / don't do that. Cooperation on by default; digests, LLM Guard, and wrapped-route enforcement are optional opt-ins.
author: myrrazor
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
